authorInfo.bio: Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth (1819–1899) wrote Capitola the madcap. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

description: "The Missing Bride" by Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth is a historical novel written during the mid-19th century. The story begins with the tale of Luckenough Manor and its youngest heiress, Edith Lance, amid the tensions and disruptions of the War of 1812.
